title: Plan approval prompt does not use the design's permission-block anatomy
observed: Verified on 02-plan-option2-highlighted.png: a stray full-width grey rule under the kiln reply, then two blank rows, then a 'plan ───' label; the body is indented 3 columns; a dashed rule frames the plan; options '1  Yes, and use auto mode' / '2  Yes, manually approve edits' / '3  Tell kiln what to change' mark the selection only by an amber digit and brighter text (no raised background); no amber top/bottom rules; the hint 'shift+tab to approve with this feedback' hangs under option 3.
expected: Same anatomy as the design's permission block: amber top/bottom rules, question row, numbered options with the selected row on the raise background and an amber key, one hint row.

fix.note: Selected-row raise covers only the key: see option-row-raise-key-only.
